name: lark-git-sync
description: Turn a repo's git commits for this week, last week, this month, last month, a custom date range or everything since the last sync into task records in a Lark Base (Bitable) table. Commits are grouped into feature tasks by ticket key, conventional-commit scope and module, and multi-part work (DB, API, UI) is split into linked subtasks. Vague messages like "fix" or "wip" are rewritten from the changed files, CHANGELOG.md and a bounded diff. Commits already synced are skipped by SHA, and nothing is written to Lark until you approve a preview. Requires the official Lark MCP server.
